questions.q_en: A sum of money amounts to Rs. 4840 in 2 years and to Rs. 5324 in 3 years at compound interest. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.q_hi: चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर कोई धनराशि 2 वर्षों में 4840 रुपये और 3 वर्षों में 5324 रुपये हो जाती है। प्रति वर्ष ब्याज की दर है:

questions.q_en: Which protocol provides e-mail facility among different hosts?
questions.q_hi: विभिन्न होस्ट के बीच ई-मेल सुविधा कौन सा प्रोटोकॉल प्रदान करता है?
questions.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used for sending emails.

questions.q_en: Which river enters Haryana near Kaleasar forest?
questions.q_hi: कौन सी नदी कालेसर वन के पास हरियाणा में प्रवेश करती है?
questions.explanation: The Yamuna river enters Haryana near Kaleasar in Yamunanagar district.

questions.q_en: A clock shows 3:30. If the minute hand points towards East, in which direction will the hour hand point?
questions.q_hi: एक घड़ी 3:30 दिखा रही है। यदि मिनट की सुई पूर्व की ओर इंगित करती है, तो घंटे की सुई किस दिशा में इंगित करेगी?
questions.explanation: At 3:30, minute hand is at 6 (South normally, but here East). It shifted +90 deg anti-clockwise. Hour hand is between 3 and 4 (SE normally), shift +90 anti-clockwise = North-East.

questions.q_en: If x + (1/x) = 5, then the value of x^3 + (1/x^3) is:
What is the full form of 'USB' in computer terminology?
questions.q_hi: कंप्यूटर शब्दावली में 'USB' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: USB stands for Universal Serial Bus.

questions.q_en: Who led the revolt of 1857 from Rewari?
questions.q_hi: रेवाड़ी से 1857 के विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
questions.explanation: Rao Tula Ram was the hero of the 1857 revolution from Rewari/Ahirwal region.

questions.q_en: Which part of the human brain controls body temperature?
questions.q_hi: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग शरीर के तापमान को नियंत्रित करता है?
questions.explanation: The Hypothalamus regulates body temperature, hunger, and thirst.

questions.q_en: A and B can do a piece of work in 12 days, B and C in 15 days, and C and A in 20 days. If A, B and C work together, they will complete the work in:
questions.q_hi: A और B एक काम को 12 दिनों में, B और C 15 दिनों में, और C और A 20 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। यदि A, B और C मिलकर काम करते हैं, तो वे काम को कितने समय में पूरा करेंगे?
questions.explanation: 2(A+B+C) efficiency = 5+4+3 = 12 units/day. (A+B+C) = 6 units/day. Total work 60. Time = 60/6 = 10 days.

questions.q_en: Select the related word: Virology : Virus :: Pathology : ?
questions.q_hi: संबंधित शब्द का चयन करें: वायरोलॉजी : वायरस :: पैथोलॉजी : ?
questions.explanation: Virology is the study of viruses; Pathology is the study of diseases.

questions.q_en: Which of the following dance forms is performed by men only?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा नृत्य केवल पुरुषों द्वारा किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Dhamal dance is performed by men, typically in the Ahirwal region during moonlight.

questions.q_en: In binary system, 1 KB (Kilobyte) is equal to:
questions.q_hi: बाइनरी सिस्टम में, 1 KB (किलोबाइट) किसके बराबर है?
questions.explanation: 1 KB = 2^10 bytes = 1024 bytes.

questions.q_en: The ratio of the ages of A and B is 3:4. Four years ago, the ratio was 5:7. What is the present age of B?
questions.q_hi: A और B की आयु का अनुपात 3:4 है। चार वर्ष पूर्व, अनुपात 5:7 था। B की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?

questions.q_en: Where is the 'Central Buffalo Research Institute' located?

questions.q_en: pH value of pure water is:

questions.q_en: Which amendment of the Indian Constitution gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions?
questions.q_hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस संशोधन ने पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया?
questions.explanation: 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj.

questions.q_en: Which soil in Haryana is locally known as 'Rausli'?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में किस मिट्टी को स्थानीय रूप से 'रौसली' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Sandy Loam Soil (Retili Domat) is locally called Rausli. It is good for crops like wheat and mustard.

questions.q_en: Optical fibers work on the principle of:
questions.q_hi: ऑप्टिकल फाइबर किस सिद्धांत पर कार्य करते हैं?
questions.explanation: Optical fibers transmit data using Total Internal Reflection (TIR) of light.

questions.q_en: Who was the first Chief Minister of Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के पहले मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे?

questions.q_en: In which district is the 'Sultanpur National Park' located?
